translationRepairs: Yet at lunar culmination the horizontal parallax is smallest while true motion is slowest, which would make the separation distance larger.

s0077 places the Moon 在最高時 with 地半徑差最小 and 月實行必遲. Smallest horizontal parallax and slowest true motion mark lunar apogee, not meridian culmination; 'at apogee' restores the orbital sense of 最高.
